headlines.english_claim: The actual inner completion list-program realizer has polynomial tree cost, including the supplied word.

headlines.english_claim: Completion program code agrees on every full reserved word with a feasible coarse-table draw, and its uniform-word law is within 2^-h of ordinary coarse-table uniform law.
hypotheses: Natural d with 14<=d; R:Fin(m+1)->Nat, P:Fin(n+1)->Nat; equal totals.
Every R_i >= (n+1)*(3*d), every P_j >= (m+1)*(3*d); h any natural.
headlines.name: Math115.CompletionSamplerSemantics.draw_semantics
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (d : ℕ) (hd : 14 ≤ d) (R : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ) (P : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ) (htotal : ∑ i, R i = ∑ j, P j),
  m + 1 ≤ d →
    n + 1 ≤ d →
      m * n ≤ d - 1 →
        (∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)), (n + 1) * (3 * d) ≤ R i) →
          (∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), (m + 1) * (3 * d) ≤ P j) →
            ∀ (h : ℕ),
              (∀ (bits : Fin (Math115.DenseLatticeCompletion.completionBits d R P h) → Bool),
                  Math115.CompletionSamplerProgram.draw
                      (Math115.CompletionSamplerSemantics.parameters d R P h, List.ofFn bits) =
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode
                      ↑(Math115.CompletionSamplerSemantics.programTable d hd R P htotal h bits)) ∧
                OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
                      (Math115.CompletionSamplerSemantics.programTable d hd R P htotal h))
                    (Math115.LatticeCompletionAccuracy.originalUniform R P
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.GreedyFeasibleTable.table R P htotal)) ≤
                  Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h

headlines.english_claim: Ideal-scale feasible chain satisfies variance <=80000*d^17*energy for every real observable.
hypotheses: Finite linearly ordered I,J; natural margins with equal totals; H:IdealStates r c->Real.
headlines.name: Math115.IdealRepairRefinement.feasibleChain_poincare_d17_refined
headlines.statement:
∀ {I J : Type u} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : LinearOrder I] [inst_3 : LinearOrder J] (r : I → ℕ)
  (c : J → ℕ) (htotal : ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j) (H : Math115.IdealOracleScales.IdealStates r c → ℝ),
  (Math115.IdealOracleScales.feasibleChain r c htotal).variance H ≤
    128 * 5 ^ 4 * ↑OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance ^ 17 *
      (Math115.IdealOracleScales.feasibleChain r c htotal).energy H

headlines.english_claim: For every exact reserved word, the list result is matrixCode of the same two-branch physical experiment.
hypotheses: Equal-total natural finite margins; any natural h; bits have exact scheduled outerBits width.
headlines.name: Math115.LatticeSampler.draw_code
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (htotal : ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j) (h : ℕ)
  (bits :
    Fin
        (Math115.PhysicalReferenceBoolean.outerBits r
          (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.walkCount (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalSmallCount r c)
            OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance
            (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalMassBase r) h)
          (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.restartCount (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalSmallCount r c) h)
          (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.stepPrecision (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalSmallCount r c)
            OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance
            (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalMassBase r) h)
          (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.terminalPrecision (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalSmallCount r c)
            h)) →
      Bool),
  Math115.LatticeSampler.draw (((List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c), h), List.ofFn bits) =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode
      ↑(Math115.PhysicalBooleanSampler.draw r c htotal
          (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.walkCount (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalSmallCount r c)
            OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance
            (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalMassBase r) h)
          (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.restartCount (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalSmallCount r c) h)
          (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.stepPrecision (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalSmallCount r c)
            OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance
            (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalMassBase r) h)
          (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.terminalPrecision (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalSmallCount r c) h)
          bits)

headlines.english_claim: Feasible table-valued witness agrees pointwise with draw, and uniform exact q-bit bank gives normalized TV<=2^-h.
hypotheses: Equal-total natural finite margins; h any natural (zero permitted); q is this schedule totalBits.
headlines.name: Math115.LatticeSampler.draw_spec
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (htotal : ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j) (h : ℕ),
  have q := Math115.LatticeScheduleProgram.totalBits ((List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c), h);
  ∃ f,
    (∀ (bits : Fin q → Bool),
        Math115.LatticeSampler.draw (((List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c), h), List.ofFn bits) =
          OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode ↑(f bits)) ∧
      ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw f)
            OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw) ≤
        ↑(Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h)

headlines.english_claim: One uniform polynomial bounds this drawRealizer cost plus output weight on every exact reserved bank.
hypotheses: Any m,n,natural r,c,h; exact q-bit word. No equal-total or h>=1 premise.
headlines.name: Math115.LatticeSamplerCost.reserved_draw_work
headlines.statement:
∃ P,
  ∀ (m n : ℕ) (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (h : ℕ)
    (bits : Fin (Math115.LatticeScheduleProgram.totalBits ((List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c), h)) → Bool),
    have z := (((List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c), h), List.ofFn bits);
    Math115.LatticeSampler.drawRealizer.cost z + OAI.MatchingFPRAS.TreeTyped.weight (Math115.LatticeSampler.draw z) ≤
      Polynomial.eval (Math115.CompletionEncodingSize.measure (List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c) h) P

headlines.english_claim: Same supplied-word work has a uniform existential polynomial bound in literal encodeMargins length+numeric h+3.
hypotheses: Any finite natural margins,h and exact reserved bank; no total-balance premise.
headlines.name: Math115.LatticeSamplerCost.reserved_draw_work_literal
headlines.statement:
∃ P,
  ∀ (m n : ℕ) (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (h : ℕ)
    (bits : Fin (Math115.LatticeScheduleProgram.totalBits ((List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c), h)) → Bool),
    have z := (((List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c), h), List.ofFn bits);
    Math115.LatticeSampler.drawRealizer.cost z + OAI.MatchingFPRAS.TreeTyped.weight (Math115.LatticeSampler.draw z) ≤
      Polynomial.eval ((OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.encodeMargins r c).length + h + 3) P

headlines.english_claim: Uniform positive Ctime and natural Dtime bound actual machineTime in original samplingSize.
hypotheses: All dimensions and natural margins with equal totals; h>=1. Constants quantified before dimensions/margins/h.
headlines.name: Math115.PublicLatticeSampler.machineTime_public_bound
headlines.statement:
∃ Ctime Dtime,
  0 < Ctime ∧
    ∀ (m n : ℕ) (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ),
      ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
        ∀ (h : ℕ),
          1 ≤ h →
            Math115.PublicLatticeSampler.machineTime (OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.encodeSamplingInput r c h) ≤
              Ctime * OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.samplingSize n r h ^ Dtime

headlines.english_claim: Each original table has literal machine tableMass equal to its finite-bank tableDraw probability at that same time.
hypotheses: Equal totals; any h,t>=machineTime; X:Table r c.
headlines.name: Math115.PublicLatticeSampler.machine_mass
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (htotal : ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j) (h t : ℕ),
  Math115.PublicLatticeSampler.machineTime (OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.encodeSamplingInput r c h) ≤ t →
    ∀ (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c),
      OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.tableMass Math115.PublicLatticeSampler.machine
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.encodeSamplingInput r c h) t ↑X =
        ↑((OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
                (Math115.PublicLatticeSampler.tableDraw r c htotal h)).mass
            X)

headlines.english_claim: Every t-bit tape halts with a feasible original table whenever t dominates machineTime of encoded input.
hypotheses: Equal totals; h any natural; t natural with machineTime(encoded input)<=t.
headlines.name: Math115.PublicLatticeSampler.machine_outputs
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀ (h t : ℕ),
      Math115.PublicLatticeSampler.machineTime (OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.encodeSamplingInput r c h) ≤ t →

              (OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.encodeSamplingInput r c h) bits ↑X

hypotheses: Equal-total natural finite margins, h any natural; q=actual totalBits.
headlines.name: Math115.PublicLatticeSampler.public_spec
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (htotal : ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j) (h : ℕ),
  have q := Math115.LatticeScheduleProgram.totalBits ((List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c), h);
  ∃ f,
    (∀ (bits : Fin q → Bool),
        Math115.PublicLatticeSampler.publicDraw
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.encodeSamplingInput r c h, List.ofFn bits) =
          OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.encodeMatrix ↑(f bits)) ∧
      ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw f)
            OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw) ≤
        ↑(Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h)
